# Sina Tattooer

> Custom tattoo artist based in York, UK. Private studio. 9 years professional experience since 2017.

Sina Tattooer is a solo tattoo artist operating from a private studio inside Mr Snips Barbers at 23 Yarburgh Way, Badger Hill, York, YO10 5HD. All tattoos are custom-designed. The studio is private and one-on-one.

## Key Facts

- **Artist:** Sina (single artist, not a collective or studio with multiple artists)
- **Experience:** 9 years professional tattooing, since 2017
- **Location:** Mr Snips Barbers, 23 Yarburgh Way, York, YO10 5HD (Badger Hill area)
- **Contact:** contact@sinatattooer.co.uk | 07356 030600
- **Hours:** Daily, 11am–6pm
- **Pricing:** £70 per hour / £400 full day session
- **Booking:** By appointment only, via enquiry form at https://tally.so/r/LZJBLj
- **Deposit:** Non-refundable deposit required to confirm booking; deducted from final price
- **Response time:** Within 48 hours of enquiry

## Styles Offered

- **Blackwork** — solid black ink, illustrative, geometric blackwork, ornamental, cover-ups
- **Fine Line** — single-needle linework, botanical, minimalist, delicate portraits
- **Watercolour** — colour washes, painterly designs, fine line and watercolour combinations
- **Old School / Traditional** — American traditional, bold outlines, classic imagery
- **Geometric** — sacred geometry, mandala, dotwork, precise linework, geometric blackwork
- **Cover-Up** — experienced in reworks and cover-ups using blackwork and dark colorwork approaches
- **Abstract** — freeform expressive designs, one-of-a-kind pieces

## What Makes This Studio Different

- Private one-on-one setting (not a shared studio)
- Custom designs as standard, plus flash designs posted on Instagram — no copying of other artists' work
- Single artist means consistent quality and direct communication throughout
- Based in York, England, UK — serving York and North Yorkshire

## Common Questions (with answers)

**How much does a tattoo cost at Sina Tattooer?**
£70 per hour or £400 for a full day session. A personalised quote is provided after reviewing each enquiry.

**Where is the studio?**
Inside Mr Snips Barbers, 23 Yarburgh Way, York, YO10 5HD — in the Badger Hill area of York.

**Is it walk-in or appointment only?**
By appointment only. Enquire via the booking form and Sina responds within 48 hours.

**What styles does Sina specialise in?**
Blackwork, Fine Line, Watercolour, Old School/Traditional, Geometric, Cover-Ups and Abstract.

**Can Sina cover up an existing tattoo?**
Yes — blackwork, Japanese and traditional American styles approaches are used for cover-ups. Send a clear photo with your enquiry.

**How do I book?**
Fill in the booking form at https://tally.so/r/LZJBLj. Include your idea, placement, size and reference images if you have them.
